profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer at The Coca-Cola Company
profile.summary:
With a full-stack focus, I am currently working at The Coca-Cola Company on the Transaction Growth team. The team and product are very new, and I am looking forward to contributing to the development and growth.

Additionally, I worked as a software engineer at Visa on the Payment Hub team where I developed internal tools like Visa's Holiday Calendar. I previously contributed to Visa's ERS Bank Account Reconciliation team where I also had a full-stack focus. I provided 24/7 production support in rotational shifts and partake in Agile methodologies for project delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Development: Experience in Java, Spring Boot, and NodeJS to develop backend microservices and modules. Notable examples include constructing REST APIs, crafting service and utility methods, and designing entity classes.

Frontend Development: Utilize React (and formerly Angular) to expand frontend user interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with backend services.

Database Management: Create MySQL queries for both local and production environments to facilitate efficient database interactions.

Code Quality Assurance: Implement best practices to assess and enhance code quality, employing tools such as SonarQube to uphold high standards of performance and reliability.

24/7 Production Support: Assess and manage application and server issues on week-long rotational shifts, maintaining system stability and uptime.

Agile Development: Engage in Agile methodologies with 2-week sprints, actively participating in daily scrum meetings to foster collaboration and deliver high-quality software solutions.

Employee Resource Group Participation: Fulfill dual roles within the VAST (Visa Asians Standing Together) ERG, organizing impactful events and promoting inclusivity.

Community Engagement: Serve on the PPD Learning and Engagement Committee Group, contributing to planning and day-of support. Coordinated on planning committee a tech department event called the Midtown Amazing Race.

Team Support: Coordinate team bonding activities and celebrations, including potlucks, work anniversaries, and team lunches. 

Mentorship: Served as an "Intern Buddy," providing mentorship and guidance to support the professional growth and success of the team's intern.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Angular · Production Support · Front-End Development · Back-End Development · Full-Stack Development · Computer Science · Team Building · Employee Resource Groups (ERG)

positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Engaged teaching assistant adept at supporting professor inside and outside the classroom through student assistance. Conducted insightful office hours to clarify concepts related to parallelism and Java programming. Collaborated with professor to generate ideas aimed at enriching the learning experience and improving student comprehension. Passionate about fostering an environment conducive to learning and growth.
